verdict.rationale: UK Visas and Immigration runs online services (applications, eVisas, ETA, the ID Check app), so opting out of analytics or usage tracking is a fair question for this kind of service. The evidence pack has nothing on cookie consent, analytics controls, or telemetry opt-out. The page on seeing the personal information UKVI holds about you is a data-access feature, not a tracking opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
